# CASHIO.US — Sovereign AI Under Human Command

> Doug Cashio, Pensacola, Florida. Creative AI technologist with 20+ years in enterprise environments. This site documents ZeusApollo, an independently built sovereign AI system: owned hardware, quality gated model routing, and public safe proof. Every published figure is dated, scoped, and expires on purpose.

Current release: v31 "The Grid". Figures verified August 10, 2026 by an owner run live check over cluster SSH by E.V.E., the Evaluation Verification Engine; valid 30 days or until the next architecture change. Machine readable figures: https://cashio.us/status.json

## The system

- Two Proxmox hosts run 19 documented containers, all 19 verified running at the August 10, 2026 check. The cluster is quorate. Athena is a physical edge and quorum device. Atlas is a standalone gateway and local inference host, deliberately counted outside the container total.
- Ten public capability lanes route by a single law: quality picks the model, cost only breaks a tie. Free and local lanes carry routine work; frontier adjudication activates only when consequence earns it.
- Behind the gateway sits a private model catalog of 36 entries. Ten public lanes and 36 catalog entries count different objects and are never merged into one figure.
- Operational at the August 10, 2026 check: Atlas LiteLLM gateway, Technitium DNS primary and secondary, Wazuh, Prometheus, n8n, PBS, and media services.

## What is deliberately withheld

Addresses, ports, credentials, capacity, AI operating cost, automation job counts, DNS query samples, backup recovery telemetry, and security update counts. A figure with no fresh measurement is omitted entirely rather than published stale.

## Builds

- Hermes Orchestrator — one gateway in front of every model lane
- Exposure Assessment — OSINT and cloud exposure into one remediation picture
- ZeusApollo Dashboard Suite — operations dashboards for fleet health, routing and service status
- Sovereign Intelligence Briefing — executive facing analysis of AI, security and infrastructure
- The Shop Floor Signal — operations intelligence for industrial teams
- Graphify — a navigable code graph with community driven documentation
- Escalation Cascade — four tier autonomous exception detection
